references.text: Aaron's sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar are mentioned for the first time here in connection with Aaron's genealogy.
Nadab and Abihu died when they offered unauthorized fire before the Lord.
The names of Aaron's four sons are repeated, and it is told about the death of Nadab and Abihu and how Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
Aaron's sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar are mentioned in the genealogy in 1 Chronicles.
Aaron's four sons are mentioned in connection with the organization of the priestly service under David.
